tools.name: ingest_sources
tools.purpose: Register user-provided design and manufacturing artifacts for a project.
tools.input_summary: Project id plus paths to datasheets, schematics, BOM/placement files, Gerbers, drill files, IPC-356 netlists, routing reports, or reference documents; paths are deterministically classified before normalization.
tools.output_summary: InputArtifact records, deterministic artifact type detection results, and EvidenceSource records prepared for later normalization.

tools.name: ingest_knowledge
tools.purpose: Absorb datasheets, OpenMV reference documents, and component documents into the reusable component knowledge base.
tools.input_summary: Part numbers, OpenMV document paths, datasheet paths, URLs, and optional manufacturer/package hints.
tools.output_summary: ComponentKnowledge, reusable knowledge key, and DesignIntent placeholders with pinout, package, interface, layout-guideline, confidence, and knowledge-gap fields.

tools.name: reuse_knowledge
tools.purpose: Reuse a normalized component knowledge record for a later design or reconstruction request.
tools.input_summary: Project id, part number, and optional datasheet/reference document paths used to seed the reusable placeholder record.
tools.output_summary: DatasheetIngestionResult marked as reused, including reusable key, ComponentKnowledge placeholder, warnings, and pending trust/freshness checks.

tools.name: normalize_sources
tools.purpose: Convert raw project artifacts into normalized evidence records.
tools.input_summary: Project id and selected InputArtifact ids.
tools.output_summary: EvidenceRef records linked to component knowledge, design intent, and BoardDesign IR targets.

tools.name: reconstruct_board
tools.purpose: Reconstruct a BoardDesign IR from Rockbox-style Gerber, drill, IPC, routing, and placement evidence.
tools.input_summary: Project id plus Rockbox manifest inputs: component placement/BOM files, Gerber/artwork files, drill files, IPC-356 netlists, routing reports, and unknown files.
tools.output_summary: BoardDesign IR placeholder with artifact-count confidence summary until real component, Gerber, drill, and IPC parsing is implemented.

tools.name: generate_board
tools.purpose: Generate a BoardDesign IR candidate from requirements, OpenMV design intent, and datasheet-derived component knowledge.
tools.input_summary: Project id, target function, selected components, constraints, OpenMV DesignIntent id, and reusable ComponentKnowledge ids.
tools.output_summary: BoardDesign IR candidate plus assumptions, confidence, and knowledge gaps.

tools.name: validate_design
tools.purpose: Run deterministic checks before a design is considered usable or exportable, including placeholder Gerber export validation.
tools.input_summary: Project id, BoardDesign IR version, and optional generated Gerber output paths.
tools.output_summary: Validation findings, placeholder Gerber validation warnings, confidence impacts, and blocking warnings.

tools.name: export_gerber
tools.purpose: Plan export of approved BoardDesign IR into Gerber/manufacturing outputs.
tools.input_summary: Project id, approved BoardDesign IR version or board_design_id, export settings, and fab constraints.
tools.output_summary: Placeholder manufacturing package paths, export report path, and warnings until real Gerber generation is implemented.

tools.name: produce_report
tools.purpose: Produce a human-readable reconstruction, generation, and export report for current BoardDesign IR outputs.
tools.input_summary: Project id, optional board_design_id, and artifact references that should be cited in the report.
tools.output_summary: DesignReport placeholder with summary, assumptions, warnings, artifact references, and send-to-fab readiness caveats.

tools.name: open_viewer
tools.purpose: Return a /bodesign/ viewer URL for the current project or board design.
tools.input_summary: Project id and optional BoardDesign IR version or view state.
tools.output_summary: Viewer URL and suggested display context for the host IDE/agent.
